question: What is the term for : "A literary or rhetorical device in which the opposite of what is expected occurs"?
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Situational Irony**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Situational Irony** refers to a literary or rhetorical device in which the opposite of what is expected occurs. (स्थिति विडंबना) • **Example:** A fire station burns down. It is ironic because a fire station is supposed to prevent fires, not be consumed by one. • It is often used in storytelling to create surprise or humor, highlighting the unpredictability of life. (जीवन की अप्रत्याशितता को दर्शाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Situational Irony**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Antithesis** (विरोधाभास): A rhetorical device where two opposite ideas are put together in a sentence to achieve a contrasting effect. • **Example:** "It was the best of times, it was the worst of times." — Charles Dickens. • **Verbal Irony** (मौखिक विडंबना): A figure of speech in which what is said is the opposite of what is meant. • **Example:** Saying "What a pleasant day!" during a thunderstorm. • **Paradox** (विरोधाभास): A statement that contradicts itself but might still be true. • **Example:** "This is the beginning of the end." 48:Tf50, सही उत्तर है: **विकल्प 4** अर्थात् **स्थितिजन्य विडंबना**।
